item.title: Tecnologo: Integrated Energy Systems Experimental Infrastructure (INTEGRAL), Project code EFRE1147, CUP D53C26001910009, Program FESR 2021 - 2027 (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-06 Macchine e sistemi per l'energia e l'ambiente

The candidate will be responsible for supporting the design, procurement, installation, and testing of the new laboratory infrastructure. The candidate will also be responsible for following the management and reporting procedures required by the funding agency. The position involves setting up a laboratory infrastructure, particularly for testing energy storage systems. It also involves developing energy system models that integrate renewable energy generation and energy storage systems, including through the use of optimization techniques.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-05 Sistemi di elaborazione delle informazioni

In adapt.it, we focus on the development of a new generation of adaptive running footwear that can measure plantar pressure and dynamically adjust its mechanical properties. The project combines 3Dknitted textiles, smart materials, sensing, embedded systems, real-time data processing, and mobile interaction... (see call)

item.title: Tecnologo: AMI-Q Lab (Additive Manufacturing Advanced Process Monitoring and Intelligence Quality Lab) (AMI-Q Lab), Project code EFRE1156, Program FESR 2021 - 2027 (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-04 Tecnologie e sistemi di lavorazione

The technologist will carry out technical and operational research-support activities in the AMI-Q Lab for Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) of metals and polymers. Tasks include supporting the specification and procurement of equipment and installing, commissioning and integrating two industrial LPBF systems, the optical and acoustic in-situ monitoring systems and the IT infrastructure (incl. Profinet interfaces). The technologist will be responsible for calibrating machines and sensors, preparing build jobs, carrying out experiments and DoE test series, acquiring and managing process data, safe powder handling and day-to-day lab operation. Further tasks include manufacturing demonstrators,…

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIET-01 Elettrotecnica

Support the establishment, commissioning, and operation of the NanoStructurLab, including acquisition, preparation and installation of a 2PP system, development of operating and maintenance procedures, process optimization, and routine technical support. item.title: Tecnologo: Project LANDFEED "Unlocking efficient bio-based fertilisers for soil sustainability from underutilised side streams" Call HORIZON-JU-CBE-2023 - Grant Agreement n. 101157636/2024 (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/ICHI-02 Impianti e processi industriali chimici

LANDFEED – Transforming Waste into Sustainable Biofertilisers is a Horizon Europe project aimed at transforming agri-food, forestry and urban waste and by-products into biofertilisers through targeted technologies and circular solutions. The project is structured around five Use Cases: UC1 (Spain): transformation of HORECA food waste into biofertiliser through solid-state fermentation using filamentous fungal strains; UC2 (France): transformation of animal-derived residues into biofertiliser through twin-screw extrusion and enzymatic hydrolysis; UC3 (Greece): Transformation of olive residues into fertilising ash through biomass combustion drying with integrated CO₂ capture; UC4 (Italy):…
